title: Practice: Chopping Elbow
source: Practice Mode tutorial. The move is in the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Muay Thai › Chopping Elbow: cues, mistakes, next), named from the owner's footage by Claude; the owner corrects the name at approval. Thai: Sok Sap (ศอกสับ). Footage: the owner's clip 7 (ring, 2026-10-31), raw-footage/practice/p7.mp4. One shot; the owner starts at the frame's edge and steps in, so the cut uses the reps from 2 s on (chops at about 2.4, 4.0 and 5.6 s).

cues.text: Raise the elbow high and tight
cues.label: RAISE
cues.say: Coach: "Point up, hand by your ear, elbow tight to your head. No wide swing."

cues.label: WEIGHT
cues.say: Coach: "Sink as it falls. Your body weight comes down with the elbow."

cues.text: Cut straight down with the point
cues.label: THE POINT
cues.say: Coach: "Straight down the middle, point first, like a hammer."

watch.label: WIDE
watch.say: Coach: "Wide means slow and they see it. It travels in a straight line, up and down."
